array_interpretation: finite-volume cell averages; q indexed [x,variables] or [x,y,variables]

shu_osher.initialization: analytic sinusoidal cell averages, discontinuity aligned to cell face
shu_osher.boundary: zero normal derivative (constant extrapolation) at each endpoint
shu_osher.method: component-wise conservative finite-volume WENO5-JS, HLLC, SSPRK(3,3)
shu_osher.uncertainty: compare n1600 and n3200 after conservative restriction

double_mach.initialization: cell-center hot if x < 1/6+y/sqrt(3); cold otherwise
double_mach.bottom_boundary: hot for x<1/6; reflecting slip wall otherwise
double_mach.top_boundary: hot if x<1/6+(1+20*t)/sqrt(3); cold otherwise, at actual RK stage time
double_mach.uncertainty: compare ny64 and ny128 after 2x2 conservative restriction
double_mach.scope: broad density and shock structure only; not a fine-scale vortex or exact-solution reference

primary_sources.citation: Jiang & Shu (1996), Efficient Implementation of Weighted ENO Schemes
Shu & Osher (1989), Efficient implementation of essentially non-oscillatory shock-capturing schemes II
Woodward & Colella (1984), The numerical simulation of two-dimensional fluid flow with strong shocks
NASA LAVA Double Mach Reflection tutorial
